summary: EV4 and the Problem-C design optimizer ran under a frozen pre-registration (frozen 2026-10-01T20:09:26Z, before any solve), as off-chain public synthetic DEVELOPMENT evidence under the owner's 2026-10-01 approval of RunPod use; spend was USD 2.48 of a USD 15 cap across seven A40 pods, each terminated and verified. 840 decision references (835 OK, 5 typed reference failures) and 100 GPU-reconstructed members (99 eligible; MLP, DeepONet and kNN families). H1 is UNRESOLVED: the proposed decision-aware rule's Kendall tau with decision quality on the 12 verification conditions was 0.262 against the deciding rule's 0.403, a difference of -0.142 with a 95 % paired bootstrap interval of [-0.275, +0.121]; neither rule is shown better. H2 holds: the proposed rule ranks the boundary-optimist control below all 99 eligible members, the deciding rule at or above all of them. H3 finds the blind spot in real models: 56 of 99 eligible members make at least one reference-verified false acceptance, several of them ranked in the top 10 under either rule. Problem C (one two-step fast-charge protocol for 15-35 degC): three of five pre-selected members chose c1 1.0 C with c2 0.7 or 0.675 C, which the reference verified with no in-band violation at 50 points (2-4 unresolved), while the conservative baseline missed the constant-voltage phase within the hour at 15 of 50; two members correctly abstained. The adversarial search verified 29 in-band and 17 out-of-band violations, emitted as findings. No exam rule, reward, weight, chain state or qualification changes.
